name: deep-pdf-editor
description: A fully client-side PDF editor that edits real PDF content streams, preserving original fonts.

scripts.release: npm run build && mkdir -p release && cp dist/index.html release/deep-pdf-editor.html
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types tests/engine.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/stress.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/quality.test.ts
